senses.gloss: m. pl. (שָׁפַךְ) that which is poured out into the gutter, waste-water.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:1">Sabb. VIII, 1</cite> <he>וכל הש׳ וכ׳</he> and the measure for all kinds of dirty waters is one-fourth of a Log (for Sabbath laws).
